source: CUT! CUT! CUT! Team Review v3.0
timing: Estimated reading durations; no voice-over supplied.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: People say a camera captures the truth.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: I don't think that's true.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: It only captures what someone chooses to show you.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: And I think... that's what makes films so interesting.

cues.speaker: CREW A
cues.text: Morning, Director. We're almost ready in the front room.

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: Good. How's the set looking?

cues.speaker: CREW A
cues.text: A few pieces still need placing. Thought you'd want the final say.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Morning, Mr. Surya.

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: Morning, Maya. Ready for your first scene?

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: As ready as I'll ever be.

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: Don't worry about getting everything perfect. We'll work through it.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: That's reassuring. I've been going over the script all morning.

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: You'll be fine. Let's take a look at the room.

cues.speaker: LARAS (MAYA)
cues.text: It's strange being back.

cues.speaker: LARAS
cues.text: I thought I'd remember every corner of this place.

cues.speaker: LARAS
cues.text: Wait...

cues.speaker: LARAS
cues.text: Wasn't there a doorway here?

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Sorry... should I come around this side instead?

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: The blocking's a bit cramped. I should cut and clear some space.

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: CUT! Let's open up that walkway. We'll go again.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: I'm not quite sure what I'm meant to notice.

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: The composition isn't helping her find the moment.

cues.speaker: LARAS
cues.text: I could've sworn there was a door here.

cues.speaker: LARAS
cues.text: Maybe I'm remembering it wrong.

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: CUT! Lovely. That felt very natural.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Thanks. I wasn't sure if I held that last pause too long.

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: No, it worked. Gave the moment a bit of space.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Great. One down, then.

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: One down.

cues.speaker: CREW A
cues.text: Shall we clear the room?

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: Yes, please. Let's move on to the kitchen.

cues.speaker: CREW B
cues.text: I'll bring the lighting kit through.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Because when you're watching a film...

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: You're only seeing a small part of what's happening.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Everything outside that frame...

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Well, you just have to imagine it, don't you?

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: It's funny how easily we do that.

cues.speaker: CREW B
cues.text: Careful with that cable.

cues.speaker: CREW C
cues.text: I've got it.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: This next one's the scene with the floor plan, right?

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: That's right. You're starting to piece things together.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Okay. So she's curious, but she's trying not to frighten herself.

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: Exactly. Don't play the fear too early.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Got it.

cues.speaker: LARAS
cues.text: Kitchen... dining room... stairs...

cues.speaker: LARAS
cues.text: That can't be right.

cues.speaker: LARAS
cues.text: If this drawing's accurate...

cues.speaker: LARAS
cues.text: ...there should be another room here.

cues.speaker: LARAS
cues.text: Why would someone close it off?

cues.speaker: LARAS
cues.text: Hello?

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Sorry, I can't quite get into position.

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: The cabinet's getting in the way of the shot. Better move it.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: I'm having trouble seeing the detail.

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: The wall's getting lost in shadow. I need to reposition that light.

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: CUT! Fantastic. That'll work beautifully.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: That knocking sound caught me off guard.

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: Sorry. We should've given you a warning.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: No, it's fine. I think it helped.

cues.speaker: CREW B
cues.text: Got a bit of a creaky old building here.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Well, that's one way to save on sound effects.

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: Alright. Let's move on before we lose the light.

cues.speaker: CREW C
cues.text: Back room's through here, Director.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: There's another room?

cues.speaker: CREW C
cues.text: Yeah. Bit tucked away.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: This building gets stranger the further in you go.

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: Which is rather useful for our film.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: And then there's editing.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: You can take two completely different moments...

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Put them together...

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: And suddenly, they tell a story.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: But that doesn't mean it's what really happened.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Does it?

cues.speaker: CREW A
cues.text: This is the last set, sir.

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: Good. Let's make it count.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: So this is where Laras finally finds out what happened?

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: Yes. Everything should come together here.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Right.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: It's a good ending.

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: Let's hope we do it justice.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: I'll do my best.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Sorry, this doesn't quite match the reference.

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: The continuity's off. I should check the chair placement.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Could we get a little more light here?

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: The reveal needs to read properly. I should adjust the lamp.

cues.speaker: LARAS
cues.text: So this is where it leads.

cues.speaker: LARAS
cues.text: This room...

cues.speaker: LARAS
cues.text: It's exactly the same.

cues.speaker: LARAS
cues.text: Someone was here.

cues.speaker: LARAS
cues.text: What happened to them?

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: CUT! Beautiful. That's our last scene.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Really? We're finished?

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: Nearly. Just a final pickup.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: What do you need?

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: Something simple. One final shot to close the film.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Of course.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: I suppose that's why endings matter so much.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: They make you look at everything that came before...

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: ...a little differently.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Sometimes all it takes is one last shot.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Just one.

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: Everyone, back on set, please. One last pickup.

cues.speaker: CREW A
cues.text: Copy that.

cues.speaker: CREW B
cues.text: All set, Director.

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: Thank you, everyone. Nearly done.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Can I ask a favour?

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: Go on.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Could we leave the camera running for a moment? I'd like to try something for the ending.

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: An improvisation?

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Something like that.

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: Alright. Let's give her a moment.

cues.speaker: CREW C
cues.text: Camera ready.

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: And... action.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Okay.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: I think I'm ready.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: There's something I haven't told you.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: The woman who died here...

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Her name was Evelyn.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: She was my sister.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: They said it was an accident.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: But there were four people in this house who knew what happened.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: They made a film out of it.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Then they made sure nobody would ever see it.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: I thought I wanted them to tell the truth.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: I thought that would be enough.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: It wasn't.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: There's one more thing.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Remember what I said about the frame?

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Now you've seen everything.
